project.title: Rijksmuseum Conversational AI Interface
project.description: A conversational AI interface for the Rijksmuseum.
project.introText: A conversational interface that helps visitors learn about and engage with the Rijksmuseum collection inside the museum. It is the Data Systems Project of the MSc Information Studies (2026/27), with Q42 and Curamando as stakeholders.
project.middleText: The brief asks what a visitor needs for a rich experience in the galleries and which interface attributes contribute to it, from input and output modalities to visual widgets and the context a conversation sits in, and how that experience can be measured.
